overview_description.description: Hedra is an AI research and infrastructure company building models for visual intelligence—and the inference and reinforcement learning systems that run and improve them in production. WMR, Hedra’s inference runtime, powers petabytes of pixel processing at scale, from visual generation to real-time simulation and control. Hedra is building the infrastructure for the pixel era of inference.
